grammarFocus: 第三人称单数；do / does 问答；like；can / cannot；and / but。
title: A Talk About Food, Likes, and Abilities
instructions: 这是模拟练习材料，不是官方雅思考试。听录音前先看题。录音会播放两遍。根据录音内容选择或填写答案。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文。
transcript:
Mia: Hi Leo. Do you like salad?
Leo: Yes, I do. I like salad. But I cannot cook. I can make a simple salad.
Mia: Can your sister cook?
Leo: Yes, she can. She can make cakes. She likes cakes.
Mia: Does she like sports?
Leo: No, she does not. She likes music. She can sing.
Mia: Do you like music?
Leo: Yes, I do. But I cannot sing. I can play the guitar.
Mia: Great! Does your sister like salad?
Leo: No, she does not. She likes cakes and music.
Mia: Thank you, Leo.

grammar.title: 第三人称单数；do / does 问答；like；can / cannot；and / but
grammar.explanation: 在一般现在时中，当主语是第三人称单数（如he, she, it）时，动词要加-s或-es，例如“She likes music.”。疑问句用does，例如“Does she like sports?”，回答用“Yes, she does.”或“No, she does not.”。can表示能力，否定形式是cannot，例如“I can sing.”和“I cannot cook.”。and连接两个相似的内容，but表示转折。
grammar.example: She likes music. She can sing. But I cannot sing.

questions.explanation: 主语She是第三人称单数，动词like要加-s，变成likes。
第三人称单数疑问句用Does开头，后面动词用原形like。
can的否定形式是cannot，写成一个词。

options: I like salad and I cannot cook.
I like salad but I cannot cook.
I like salad or I cannot cook.
answers: I like salad but I cannot cook.
questions.evidence: I like salad. But I cannot cook.
